label: December 7–13, 2026
intro: Christmas-market weekend: a German-style funfair at BITEC, a garden market at The Sukhothai, and the final nights of Vijit Chao Phraya.

activities.title: Christmas Festival Bangkok 2026 (German-style market + funfair)
activities.why: Funfair rides, Christmas lights and food stalls. Rides plus Santa vibes, a big crowd-pleaser for a 5-year-old.
activities.tip: Go Thursday or Friday late afternoon to beat weekend crowds. It's right at Bang Na BTS.

activities.title: Kimpton Maa-Lai gingerbread house workshop
activities.why: Build, decorate, take home. Hands-on making he'll be proud of.

activities.title: Bangkok Uncovered & Beyond Christmas Market
activities.why: Leafy garden market with makers' stalls and live entertainment, calmer than the mall crowds.
activities.tip: Good stroller-free wander. Go at 4pm and stay for the lights.

activities.title: Vijit Chao Phraya — final nights
activities.why: Last chance for the river light shows this year.
activities.tip: Pair with ICONSIAM's tree for a two-show evening.
